signal: Sirona Medical secured $45M in Series C financing and is scaling its cloud-native Unify radiology platform

email.subject1: a signal play for Sirona Medical
email.body1:
Brett, saw Sirona Medical closed $45M in Series C to scale the Unify platform.

A raise like that usually means more in-market accounts than your reps can follow up on, and ramp time on new hires only widens the gap. Our AI SDR handles the research, writing, and follow-up so each rep covers far more ground: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new headcount.

I built a signal play for Sirona off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: three drafts to your top accounts
email.body2:
Brett, quick follow-up for Sirona.

The usual SDR bottleneck post-raise is follow-up volume and response speed, the personalized touches that get dropped when reps are buried in research and CRM. That is exactly where booked meetings slip.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three of your top target accounts. Want to hop on a quick 15-minute call and I will walk you through them?
email.body3:
Brett, last bit of proof for Sirona.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Sirona's reply rate likely compares to other health-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Brett, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If lifting follow-up volume and scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Ramping a team post-raise is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SDR motion? I will tailor it to Sirona either way.
